notes.title: Third Person Camera Update and Visual Enhancements
notes.content: we just deployed a new build that includes a brand new chase camera that should make for a much more pleasant experience and also makes it way easier to see the track, anticipate corners, and navigate more smoothly and freely. we also started a few small graphics updates and fixed a minor glitch or two along the way, however the main focus was improving the default chase camera experience and some of the associated game physics. we hope you guys like it and please let us know your thoughts.
